latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Generator Hailuo — AI-powered video clip generation.

- Generate 5-second cinematic AI video clips from text prompts or uploaded images.
- No pro editing skills required; just describe your idea or upload files (MP4, JPG, PNG, WebM up to 200MB).
- Fast, cloud-based processing delivers downloadable 1080p MP4 videos in 1–2 minutes.
- Built-in session and credit management with free anonymous access.
- Support for checking status, credits, export, and uploads via simple chat commands.
